name: switch
title: Switch
summary: Turns a setting on or off immediately.
use: For settings that apply the moment they change.

options.name: label
options.description: Required. Names the setting, not the state.

rules: The label goes before the switch; the switch sits at the end of the row.
An inset track, filled with ink when on, under a raised knob.
accessibility: Exposed as a switch with its on or off state.
